run_gmock_output_test: run the gmock output test to verify Google Mock framework text output matches the golden file
generate_golden_file: generate a new golden file by running gmock_output_test.py with the --gengolden flag
normalize_test_output: normalize Google Test output by removing headers, footers, locations, and memory addresses
extract_leaky_tests: extract a list of test names that leak mock objects from test output using regex
remove_locations: remove all file location info from Google Test program output and replace with FILE colon hash
